_comment: Constraint budget, checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs (`just budget`).
`constraints` is the exact snarkjs r1cs count and must be updated in the
same commit as any circuit change, so the change lands as a reviewable diff.
`domain` is the Groth16 FFT domain the circuit must fit; exceeding it means
a larger ptau and roughly double the proving time.
Both circuits sit in 2^17 and are ceremony-paired: a spend's output leaves
are inserted by the batch circuit, so they share DEPTH = 11.
tree_update_batch is the tighter of the two, at ~17.5k of headroom against
4x6's ~30.7k, because it grew on both axes at once: four more leaf slots at
roughly 12k each, plus the depth level across all eight. It, not the
transact circuit, is what a further widening would break first.
